as_told.title: Experiment showing stones conduct electricity across a gap

plain: When voltage is induced and electric current sent into one stone of the kind used in ancient building, it is said to arc across into the next stone. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who argues that the pyramids were built to work as machines, says he and his team showed this by experiment, and in one telling he credits a collaborator named Ben. He tells it as evidence that the stones of ancient monuments could have carried electricity.
